opportunities.title: United Nations Secretariat Internship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Two- to six-month internships at UN headquarters and field offices, posted continuously, for students and recent graduates worldwide.

opportunities.title: University of Glasgow Global Leadership Scholarship 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: £10,000 tuition discount for international fee-paying students with a first-class equivalent and an offer for an eligible one-year taught master's, assessed on a rolling basis (January 2027 entry round closes 14 December 2026).

opportunities.title: University of Mississippi International Academic Excellence Scholarships 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: International first-year students from secondary schools outside the US with a GPA of 3.25 or higher (US scale) are automatically awarded USD 5,000 to USD 28,893 a year for four years at the University of Mississippi.
opportunities.description:
The University of Mississippi (Ole Miss) in Oxford, Mississippi, gives automatic merit scholarships to international first-year undergraduates who completed secondary school outside the United States. The amount depends on the student's GPA converted to the US 4.0 scale, and the award is sent with the admission letter.

There are four tiers: Mississippi Premier (USD 28,893 a year, about 93% of tuition, for GPA 3.9-4.0, limited to 20 awardees per country each year in order of admission), Mississippi Champion (USD 12,000 a year for GPA 3.75-3.89), Mississippi Magnolia (USD 9,500 a year for GPA 3.5-3.74) and Mississippi Legacy (USD 5,000 a year for GPA 3.25-3.49). Each is renewable for four years if the conditions are met.

For African students with strong school results, applying early matters, because the top tier is capped per country and given in order of admission.
opportunities.benefits: Automatic awards per year for four years: Premier USD 28,893 (about 93% of tuition); Champion USD 12,000 (40%); Magnolia USD 9,500 (32%); Legacy USD 5,000 (17%).
requirements: First-time international freshman
Secondary school completed outside the United States
Minimum GPA 3.25 on the US 4.0 scale (3.9+ for Premier)
Meet English proficiency: e.g. IELTS 6.0, Duolingo 110, PTE-A 53 or TOEFL iBT (79, or 4.5 on the 2026 scale); Nigeria and South Africa are on the exempt list
Admitted to the University of Mississippi
documents: English proficiency scores sent directly by the testing agency (less than two years old)
opportunities.selection_process: Awards are automatic and based on GPA tier; Premier awards are limited to 20 per country per year and given in order of admission.
important_dates: Awards: automatic with the admission decision
Separate Competitive Scholarship: apply by 10 January before fall admission
opportunities.about_provider: The University of Mississippi, known as Ole Miss, is the flagship public university of Mississippi, located in Oxford. Its Office of Global Engagement runs international admissions and scholarships.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply for undergraduate admission at olemiss.edu/applynow and send official school records and English scores. No separate scholarship application is needed; the award is stated in the admission letter.
opportunities.notes: Cannot be combined with SAT/ACT scholarships (the larger award applies). Ole Miss also offers transfer international scholarships of up to 100% of non-resident tuition.

opportunities.title: University of Otago Doctoral Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Domestic and international applicants seeking a first doctorate at Otago can apply at any time for a NZ$32,544 yearly stipend plus a 36-month domestic tuition waiver.
opportunities.description:
The University of Otago Doctoral Scholarship is the university's main funding award for people starting a doctorate at Otago, New Zealand's oldest university, based in Dunedin. It supports both PhD candidates and those on professional doctorates.

The award pays a living stipend and waives domestic-level tuition fees for three years (36 months), and Otago offers up to 164 of these scholarships each year. It is open to both domestic and international students, so African applicants who secure a place and a supervisor at Otago can be considered.

The official page states that applications can be made at any time, and that selection rests mainly on academic merit and research potential, which makes a strong research proposal and academic record the key to success.
opportunities.benefits: A stipend of NZ$32,544 per year plus a waiver of domestic tuition fees for 36 months. The student services fee and insurance are not covered.
requirements: Open to both domestic and international students
Must be seeking a first doctoral qualification (PhD or professional doctorate) at the University of Otago
Selected mainly on academic merit and research potential
opportunities.selection_process: Awards are made mainly on academic merit and the applicant's potential for research. Up to 164 scholarships are awarded each year.
opportunities.about_provider: The University of Otago is a research-intensive public university in Dunedin, New Zealand. It funds doctoral study through a range of scholarships, of which the Doctoral Scholarship is the main one.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply for doctoral admission at the University of Otago and follow the scholarship application instructions given on the university's how-to-apply pages. Contact a potential supervisor in your field first, since admission depends on supervision being available.
opportunities.notes: The award does not pay the student services fee or insurance, so budget for these. Check the scholarship regulations linked from the official page before applying.

opportunities.title: University of Surrey International Excellence Award (Postgraduate) 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Self-funded international students with a conditional offer for most full-time taught master's starting February or September 2027 automatically receive GBP 5,000 off tuition.
opportunities.description:
The International Excellence Award at the University of Surrey gives international students GBP 5,000 off the tuition fee of a full-time taught master's, with no separate application. It applies to courses starting in February 2027 or September 2027 and is open regardless of nationality.

The award goes to overseas fee-paying students who pay their own fees, so it suits African applicants who are self-funding or funded by family rather than by a government or employer sponsor. For two-year master's it covers the first year only.

A handful of courses are excluded, including the MBA and several science master's, so applicants should check the list before relying on the discount.
opportunities.benefits: GBP 5,000 off tuition fees (first year only for two-year courses). It cannot be paid in cash or used for accommodation and cannot be combined with alumni or early-bird discounts.
requirements: Overseas (international) fee status
Conditional offer for a full-time taught master's starting February or September 2027
Self-funded: fees paid from your own or family funds, not a government, employer or other scholarship
Not progressing from the Surrey International Study Centre

Course not on the exclusion list (part-time, distance learning, MBA, MSc Applied Analytical Chemistry, MSc AI (Conversion), MSc Biotechnology, MSc Food Science, MSc Human Nutrition, MSc Pharmaceutical Sciences)
documents: No separate application: the award follows from the master's application
opportunities.selection_process: Awarded automatically on a first-come, first-served basis to eligible applicants; a scholarship letter is sent about five days after the conditional offer.
opportunities.about_provider: The University of Surrey is a UK university in Guildford known for its links with industry, professional training placements and research in engineering, health and the sciences.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply for an eligible full-time taught master's at Surrey. If eligible you receive a scholarship letter after your conditional offer; accept the offer in the applicant portal and pay the deposit to secure it.
opportunities.notes: Contact: international@surrey.ac.uk.

opportunities.title: VU Block Model International Scholarship 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: New international students starting an eligible foundation, bachelor's or coursework master's at VU Melbourne are automatically assessed for up to 30% off tuition.
opportunities.description:
The VU Block Model International Scholarship is a tuition reduction from Victoria University (VU) in Melbourne, Australia, for new international students. Applicants to foundation, undergraduate and postgraduate coursework courses are assessed for it automatically when they apply for a course.

The award can reduce tuition fees by up to 30%. It is named after VU's Block Model, in which students take one unit at a time in short, intensive blocks. The official page does not give an intake year or a separate scholarship deadline, so the discount follows the normal course application timetable.

For African applicants, the attraction is that no extra essay or form is needed: a complete course application with certified documents and English test results puts you in consideration.
opportunities.benefits: Up to 30% off tuition fees for new international students in eligible courses. No living allowance is mentioned.
requirements: New international student starting at VU Melbourne
Eligible foundation, undergraduate or postgraduate coursework course
English test (IELTS Academic, TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, C1 Advanced or B2 First) taken no more than two years before the course starts, unless exempt through English-medium study
Course-specific requirements where applicable (work experience, portfolio, police check)
documents: Certified academic transcripts and supporting documents
opportunities.selection_process: Applicants are assessed automatically for the scholarship when their course application is processed; competitive courses rank applicants for admission.
important_dates: Apply by the standard course application deadline for your intake
Credit applications: at least 10 business days before the course application deadline
opportunities.about_provider: Victoria University is a public dual-sector university in Melbourne, Australia, offering vocational, undergraduate and postgraduate study. It teaches most courses through its Block Model of one subject at a time.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply directly through VU's online portal (eaams.vu.edu.au) or through an education agent (agents are compulsory for applicants from some countries). Upload certified transcripts, English results and your passport; the scholarship is assessed with the application.
opportunities.notes: Tuition fees are adjusted each year. Check the VU international scholarships page for the full terms before accepting an offer.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students aged 20 or over, after three years of full-time study in a relevant field, can apply to vacancies posted continuously; a living allowance is paid to interns who need financial support.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: International undergraduates admitted to Webster receive renewable tuition-only academic scholarships.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Mid-career researchers based in the UK or at eligible organisations in low- and middle-income countries in Africa or Asia can apply at any time for up to about £250,000 a year for roughly 8 years of research.

opportunities.title: Western Michigan University Global Education Undergraduate Merit Scholarship 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: New international undergraduates on F-1 or J-1 visas with at least a 3.0/4.0 GPA admitted to Western Michigan University can receive up to USD 10,000 a year, awarded on a rolling basis.
opportunities.description:
The Global Education Undergraduate Merit Scholarship is Western Michigan University's main merit award for international bachelor's students. It is managed by the Haenicke Institute for Global Education and is offered to students starting at WMU in Kalamazoo, Michigan, either straight from secondary school or as transfer students.

The scholarship is worth up to USD 10,000 per year, paid in two halves for the fall and spring semesters, and can be held for up to eight semesters or until graduation, whichever comes first. It is applied only to WMU academic tuition. Awards are made on a rolling basis while money lasts, and the university says it receives more eligible applicants than it can fund.

Because there is no separate application, African students simply need to complete their WMU admission file early. Students admitted for fall, spring or summer can be considered.
opportunities.benefits: Up to USD 10,000 per year towards WMU tuition, paid in two instalments (fall and spring), for up to eight semesters or until graduation.
requirements: Initial F-1 or J-1 visa undergraduate (first-year or transfer)
Non-resident international status
Cumulative GPA of at least 3.0 on a 4.0 scale (international grades are converted)
Admitted to WMU for fall, spring or summer
Not fully funded by a government/NGO scholarship or a full WMU assistantship
Not enrolled in a fully online programme
documents: Complete WMU undergraduate admission application with all required materials (transcripts, English proficiency proof, financial documents as listed on the admissions page)
opportunities.selection_process: Admitted students are considered automatically. Awards depend on academic merit and the student's total estimated cost, and are made on a rolling basis until funds run out.
opportunities.about_provider: Western Michigan University is a public research university in Kalamazoo, Michigan. Its Haenicke Institute for Global Education runs international admissions and scholarships, and the university notes it is among the half of US public universities that offer a scholarship for international students.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply for undergraduate admission to Western Michigan University and submit every required document. No additional scholarship application is needed; the university reviews admitted students for the award. Apply early because funds are limited.
opportunities.notes: Cannot be combined with full government/NGO scholarships or full WMU assistantships. F and J students may face US tax withholding (14%) on aid that exceeds qualified expenses. WMU also offers a Global Education Graduate Merit Scholarship (up to USD 10,000 a year for up to four semesters).
